mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_ai_invocation ( id, tenant_id, subject_id, request_id, provider, requested_model, resolved_model, streaming, status, policy_decision, prompt_fingerprint, input_tokens, output_tokens, usage_estimated, estimated_cost, actual_cost, currency, latency_ms, provider_request_id, error_code, started_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{subjectId}, #{requestId}, #{provider}, #{requestedModel}, #{resolvedModel}, #{streaming}, #{status}, #{policyDecision}, #{promptFingerprint}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{usageEstimated}, #{estimatedCost}, #{actualCost}, #{currency}, #{latencyMillis}, #{providerRequestId}, #{errorCode}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_ai_invocation SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', resolved_model = #{resolvedModel}, provider_request_id = #{providerRequestId}, input_tokens = #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{outputTokens}, usage_estimated = #{usageEstimated}, actual_cost = #{actualCost}, latency_ms = #{latencyMillis}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'STARTED'
UPDATE ainer_ai_invocation SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, latency_ms = #{latencyMillis}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'STARTED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, subject_id, request_id, provider, requested_model, resolved_model, streaming, status, policy_decision, prompt_fingerprint, input_tokens, output_tokens, usage_estimated, estimated_cost, actual_cost, currency, latency_ms, provider_request_id, error_code, started_at, completed_at FROM ainer_ai_invocation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
